Previously known mainly as a prehistoric glue, birch tar may have doubled as a surprisingly effective natural medicine.

This does not mean that 73% of the world's animals have disappeared. Rather, it is the average decline in the size of wildlife populations being monitored.

Science.title: Ultraviolet laser pulses engineer diamond defects selectively, leaving quantum qubits intact

The challenge is learning how to control these defects without disturbing the others.
